name: WBTC (Wrapped BTC)
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the time anyone has to react
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: WBTC.owner() is the WBTC Controller, whose owner is a legacy Gnosis MultiSigWallet (6-of-10, not a Safe) with no timelock. That multisig can replace the Factory (the only address the Controller lets mint or burn), replace the Members registry, pause or unpause the token and start a transfer of the token’s own ownership.
narrative.detail: Only 4 transactions have ever been submitted through the wallet (3 executed, each in the block of its sixth confirmation, so no delay in practice) and its dailyLimit is 0; three of its ten signers are themselves contracts. Scored like Ethena’s minting contract (admin 55: a multisig over a multi-billion token with no delay). The BTC backing sits with off-chain custodians, outside this oracle’s on-chain scope.
